summary: After real vanquishing leaves at least one entry and the final disclosure prompt receives q, list_vanquished must increment program_state.stopprint so later disclosure prompts are suppressed. Its JavaScript branch calls the end.js-local name discloseStop, which is not defined in insight.js; insight.js already has the correctly named disclosureStop helper used by list_genocided.

source.branch: list_vanquished() receives q while ntypes is nonzero; the source macro done_stopprint expands to program_state.stopprint and increments it before later end-of-game disclosures.

evidence: The admitted v73 C recording reaches segment 0, step 191, key q after the lichen is killed and the vanquished prompt is shown. The exact saved baseline evaluation reports ReferenceError `discloseStop is not defined`; the saved prefix proof matches all 191 prior screens, cursors, and RNG calls through the prompt.

upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/insight.c:2780 defines done_stopprint as program_state.stopprint; lines 2848-2849 increment it when the answer is q. end.c:619-660 calls list_vanquished during disclosure, and end.c:1280 reaches disclose from really_done.

js/insight.js:2455-2457 calls discloseStop(state) in list_vanquished, but that symbol is not defined or imported in insight.js. js/end.js:913 defines a private function with that name in another module; js/insight.js:2581 defines disclosureStop(state), and list_genocided uses that helper for the same C macro behavior at js/insight.js:2621.
